L'Oréal Paris Infallible 32H Fresh Wear Foundation, Full-coverage, Longwear, Weightless Smooth Finish, Water-proof and Transfer-proof, with Vitamin C
PRODUCT DESCRIPTION


Indulge in flawless beauty with Infaillible 32H Fresh Wear Foundation. This long-lasting, high-coverage formula, enriched with vitamin C and SPF25, corrects imperfections and provides a luminous complexion for up to 32 hours.
Offers a luminous complexion that stands strong for up to 32 hours —
no transfers, just enduring radiance!
Advantages:

 	Long-lasting and high coverage for up to 32 hours;
 	New, lighter, and longer-lasting formula for a luminous complexion:
 	Corrects and minimizes the appearance of imperfections for a natural effect:
 	Enriched with vitamin C and SPF25 for added skincare benefits;
 	Offers protection against sun exposure:
 	No transfer formula for enduring radiance.
 	Quality: Made in China
